# Loki Setup Instructions

1. Start Loki using Docker:
   docker run -d --name=loki -p 3100:3100 grafana/loki:2.9.0

2. View Loki logs:
   docker logs loki

3. (Optional) Start Promtail to forward container logs:
   docker run -d --name=promtail -v /var/log:/var/log -p 9080:9080 grafana/promtail:2.9.0

4. (Optional) Use Grafana to connect to Loki and explore logs.
